clips.title: The story
paras: Warriors train and gather at the Hall of the Brave in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. The barracks and guild house serves the Horde's front-line combatants, drillmasters, and battlemasters.

The Hall of the Brave overlooks the Valley of Honor's waters and training rings. Veteran officers and seasoned warriors teach initiates melee combat, stances, and discipline. Training dummies and weapons line the hall, where battlemasters organize combatants for major military engagements across Azeroth.
